retained_limitations: The original computation punch cards and complete data printouts are located in a physical University of Illinois archival collection but were not digitally retrieved in this repository review.
The microfiche class-check supplement was identified bibliographically but its complete bytes were not preserved in the repository.
Exact machine-run dates, hardware logs, program versions, and complete execution transcripts remain unresolved and must not be inferred from the publication date.

The record may support proof completion in 1976 and detailed publication in 1977, but candidate-generation, verification, public-disclosure, publication, acceptance, and recognition dates remain distinct fields.

coding_effect.independent_coder_may_use: Only after a versioned packet update that preserves the retained limitations.
coding_effect.confidence_effect: Primary-paper and archive provenance improved; complete computational reconstructability remains unestablished.

completion_boundary: SRC-001 is terminal as LIMITATION_RETAINED. This receipt does not claim that the historic computation has been independently reconstructed or that the TIDC hypothesis is confirmed.
